articles.summary: Support for the death penalty in the US has dropped to a more than 50-year low following a botched execution in Tennessee. Forty-nine percent of American adults approve of the death penalty for convicted murderers, according to Gallup , the first time the figure has dropped below 50% since 1971. Support for the death penalty is sliding among all political groups but most among Democrats, only 28% of whom are currently in favor. Seventy-three percent of Republicans are in favor of it, as well as half of independents. The poll was taken after the botched killing by lethal injection of Christa Pike, which caused Tennessee to pause executions for the remainder of the year. Outgoing California Gov. The doctors told her that every day she went without it, she risked total paralysis, but Baruch didn’t want to have surgery right away. Her partner was in Maryland, dying of pancreatic cancer, and she wanted to be able to drive back and forth to see him in his final days. Kei vehicles (short for "keijidosha," roughly translated to "light car") are extremely popular and cheap in Japan. The average price for a kei car is typically between $6,000 and $11,000. On Tuesday, Toyota announced plans to assemble a tiny pickup, the Kei-01, at its Indiana plant in the second half of 2027. It will revive Toyota's low-cost Scion brand, which the automaker discontinued in 2016, and will initially be reserved for commercial fleets. The Kei-01 is very different from the rest of America's car market. It's nearly 4 feet shorter than a Corolla, gets a motorcycle-sized three-cylinder engine, tops out at 25 mph, and has a steering wheel on the right side.
